source.title: Irish News, 7 June 1924, p. 8 ("Ballymena Rural Council results"); Belfast News-Letter, 7 June 1924, p. 8 ("County council elections: Antrim results"); Belfast News-Letter, 1 May 1924, p. 1
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 295 - 238 = 57, the majority printed by the News-Letter (7 Jun 1924 p. 8); figures image-checked in both papers

note: Triennial election of the 23 district electoral divisions of Ballymena rural district, one member each (Belfast News-Letter, 9 May 1924). Polling in the contested divisions took place on Thursday 5 June 1924 and the results were declared on 6 June. The News-Letter's results paragraph covers the four contests only; one division (Glenbuck) had no nomination and three others that had two nominations in May produced no recorded poll and are omitted. Cumming, a sitting member, 295; Arthurs, 238 (image-checked in the Irish News, 7 Jun 1924 p. 8: "Thomas Cummings, 295; William Arthurs, 238"). The News-Letter image reads Arthurs 25[3/8] with majority 57; the majority agrees with 238, so 238 is taken (corrected from 253, gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). The News-Letter nomination list (9 May 1924 p. 2) prints 'Thomas Cumming and William Arthur (sitting members, returned unopposed)' for Kirkinriola, but both papers report a poll in the division on 5 June; the poll reports are followed.
